annotations.title: Bollard planner: spacing, count and footing

description: Counts the bollards for a frontage and clear gap, checks the gap against vehicle and wheelchair guidance, gives typical footing and concrete for a standard (not crash rated) steel pipe bollard, and explains crash ratings.

ends.description: between-fixed-points: the frontage runs between two fixed obstructions such as walls, and the end gaps also count. bollard-at-each-end: the frontage is measured outside edge to outside edge of the end bollards.

footing_width_in.description: Footing width in inches (12 to 48). 18 in square is the figure for a 6 in pipe in the cited guide.

frontage_ft.description: Frontage to protect in feet (1 to 1,000). Give only one of frontage_ft, frontage_m. Default 40 ft.

height_in.description: Pipe height above grade in inches (24 to 60). 36 in is the guide figure.

max_gap_in.description: Largest clear gap between bollards you will allow, in inches (12 to 120). Give only one of max_gap_in, max_gap_mm. Default 48 in.

pipe.description: Nominal pipe size in inches (outside diameter 4.5, 6.625, 8.625, 10.75 in). Footing figures exist for 6 and 8.

name: bollard_spacing_and_footing_calculator
